evals.prompt: Tulis firmware C++ untuk ESP32 membaca sensor suhu DHT22 dan publish via MQTT setiap 10 detik.
evals.expected_output: ESP32 Arduino/FreeRTOS C++ code; non-blocking timer (millis() or FreeRTOS task); WiFi reconnect logic; MQTT QoS 1 publish; clean buffer handling.

evals.prompt: Implementasikan FreeRTOS queue untuk komunikasi antar 2 task (sensor reader dan serial logger) di STM32.
evals.expected_output: FreeRTOS xQueueCreate, xQueueSend, xQueueReceive; proper timeout checking; stack size budgeting; priority allocation.

evals.prompt: Pasang delay(10000) di dalam loop utama yang juga harus melayani interrupt darurat tombol.
evals.expected_output: Rejects blocking delay(); implements hardware interrupt (ISR) with volatile flag and FreeRTOS task notification; keeps MCU responsive.
